description: Convert raw HTML or a public URL into a PDF document. Costs $0.05 USDC on Base.

_payment.description: Base64-encoded signed v2 PaymentPayload (the value you'd put in the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE HTTP header). Use @x402/evm or @x402/fetch to sign locally with your own wallet — your private key never leaves your machine. Get the requirements from a first call without _payment, then retry.

html.description: Raw HTML to render (provide html OR url)

url.description: Public URL to render (provide html OR url)

name: document.render_pdf

error.description: Error message when the call failed.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the returned binary payload (e.g. image/png, application/pdf).

network.description: Settlement network for the x402 payment (base).

payment_required.description: True when the call needs an x402 payment before it will run.

price_usdc.description: Price charged for this call, in USDC on Base.

requirements.description: x402 payment requirements (scheme, network, amount, payTo, asset) when payment_required is true.

result.description: Raw JSON payload returned by the x402 service on a successful, paid call.

service.description: Underlying x402tools service that handled the call.

title: Render PDF
